title: add-namespace-kms-consent-mediator-and-audit-epoch-protector
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Several Private deployment customers reported audit gaps and ambiguous key-region mappings during KMS failover and operator handoffs. This PR introduces two components to tighten compliance guarantees: (1) a lightweight NamespaceKMSConsentMediator operator that enforces per-namespace KMS consent and region pinning rules at creation/update time, and (2) an AuditEpochProtector layer in the audit forwarder that stamps epoch tokens and detects missing/rerouted sequences during downstream KMS rotation. Changes are backward-compatible by default but enable stricter enforcement via cluster feature-flag 'kms-namespace-guard'. Design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-3472/namespace-kms-consent-and-audit-epochs. Checklist: 1) Implement operator + CRD and admission validations. 2) Add audit epoch stamping and replay guard in audit pipeline. 3) Update RBAC v2 role mappings and operator policy binder. 4) Add unit and integration tests, including private-installer smoke. 5) Docs and upgrade notes. Implementation notes: the mediator validates KMS key ARN regions against namespace annotation 'redwood.kms.region' and rejects non-consented changes; it exposes a webhook admission endpoint with idempotent mutate+validate paths. AuditEpochProtector adds a monotonic epoch header (X-Audit-Epoch) and an HMAC signature tied to the operator's service key to allow downstream services to detect missing sequences after failover. Rollout plan: staged rollout behind feature flag, default off; enable for early adopter tenants in Dedicated; observe metrics 'audit_epoch_mismatch' and 'kms_consent_rejects' in console. Backwards compatibility: if feature-flag is disabled, operator runs in audit-only mode and does not reject requests. See release notes for migration steps.

release_notes: Add Namespace KMS Consent Mediator and Audit Epoch Protector. Admins can enable 'kms-namespace-guard' feature flag to enforce per-namespace KMS region pinning and strict audit epoch stamping. See docs/security/kms-namespace-guard.md and docs/upgrade/2026-02-kms-epoch-migration.md for migration and rotation steps.
